scope: Supplementary changes from saved verified observations; no fresh source retrieval and no composite standard-of-living score.

previous/current raw strings match exact archive cells

hh.limitation: Platform HH only. Resumes are not people; the index is not unemployment. Offered salary is a publisher median, not actual pay, and tax basis is unspecified.

rows.changeOrigin: published source +12.3%, nominal gross mean; not real or median income
existing derived difference of published settlement estimates; not migration or natural increase; boundary/revision effects not separated

rows.changeOrigin: published source year-on-year percent, mean asking rent excluding elite segment

interpretationLimit: A city may show different directions across these metrics. Population growth, nominal wages and HH competition do not individually establish an improvement or deterioration in living standards.
